newsitem.title: USA: Boston Scientific to shut Denmark facility.
newsitem.headline: Boston Scientific to shut Denmark facility.

text.p: Boston Scientific Corp said Thursday it would close its production facility in Stenlose, Denmark, an action that will affect 240 employees.

Boston Scientific said the shutdown, set to take place in 1997, was part of a strategy to maximize product development and manufacturing efficiency and cut costs in the wake of the company's recent merger and acquisition activities.
Boston Scientific was not available for further comment.
The Stenlose facility was acquired as part of the company's purchase of Meadox Medicals. It focused mostly on making and developing peripheral medical devices.

"This is another step in the process of maximizing operating synergies available from recent mergers and acquisitions," said Pete Nicholas, Boston Scientific chairman and chief executive officer. "We continue to pursue initiatives to realize the many synergies inherent in the consolidation process."
